label: Expanding fill button
desc: A button whose fill circle grows from the point where the pointer entered and recedes toward where it left; keyboard focus fills from the centre.
use: Primary and secondary calls to action on landing pages and sign-in.

label: Arrow relay
desc: A button where the arrow exits one side as a second arrow enters from the other on hover or focus.
use: Next, continue and view-more links in landing pages and connect flows.

label: Spotlight border
desc: A card whose border is lit by a radial gradient following the pointer; focus and touch get a steady glow.
use: Feature cards and pricing tiles on landing pages, dashboard summary cards.

label: Waving hand button
desc: A pill button with a hand glyph that waves on hover, focus or tap while the label changes to a greeting.
use: Contact, chat and welcome calls to action.

label: List image preview
desc: A list of rows where hovering shows a floating picture that trails the pointer; touch and keyboard open the picture inline.
use: Portfolio or project indexes, publishing lists, menus and case-study lists.

label: Image stack
desc: A pile of pictures that fans out on hover, keyboard focus or tap, showing a label on each.
use: Gallery and album teasers, collection cards, trip or project galleries.

label: Blinds reveal
desc: A picture revealed through vertical blind slats that turn edge-on one after another on hover, focus or tap.
use: Before/after teasers, hero images, product reveal cards.

label: Image accordion
desc: A horizontal accordion of pictures where the hovered, focused or tapped panel expands and the others shrink; arrow keys move between panels.
use: Feature showcases, destination or category pickers on landing pages.
